articles.summary: 🚨 Webinar Alert for @everyone 🚨 How do you actually measure the ROI of AI features? For most product teams, the answer is still… it depends. At @Sprout Social, that wasn’t good enough. This Thursday, join Blake Kurinsky (Blake K.) Director of Product Management at Sprout Social, as he shares how his team is using Mixpanel to close the gap between AI investment and measurable ROI— cutting time-to-insight from days to minutes and tying product improvements directly to customer value. In this live webinar, you’ll learn how his teams: ➤ Enable non-technical teams to self-serve insights ➤ Turn analysis into real, ROI-driven decisions ➤ Accelerate product iteration with confidence ➤ Measure customer value gains from AI-powered features You’ll see how these workflows can be put into practice, with Customer Success Architect Patrick M. walking through real, impact-driven examples you can apply with your team. 👉 Save your seat (https://events.mixpanel.com/how-sprout-social-accelerates-innovation-with-mixpanel/)! 📅 Dec 18 | 🕚 11AM-11:45AM PST
articles.title: Measuring ROI of AI Features: Join Our Live Webinar This Thursday!
